Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting tuition waivers for dependents of national guard members ordered to active duty to serve overseas in a war or conflict.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tuition waivers for dependents of national guardmembers ordered to active duty to serve overseas in a war or conflict;amending RCW 28B.15.910; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.15RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that when members of the Washingtonnational guard are called into overseas active duty, their absenceposes a hardship on their families in many ways. Frequently theircompensation is reduced from its normal levels, making financialobligations more difficult to meet. Therefore, the legislature intendsto support national guard members by waiving their children's tuitioncharges while they are on overseas active duty. (2) Subject to the limitations of RCW 28B.15.910, the governingboards of the state universities, the regional universities, TheEvergreen State College, and the community colleges may waive all or aportion of tuition and fees for students who: p. 1 HB 2046 (a) Are dependent children of members of the Washington nationalguard who have been ordered into federal active military service for aperiod exceeding thirty days to serve in a war or conflict fought onforeign soil; and (b) Qualify as a resident student under RCW 28B.15.012, except RCW28B.15.012(2)(g). (3) If a governing board exercises the authority under thissection, the board shall also adopt policies that provide a full orpartial refund of tuition already paid for a quarter or semester duringwhich a student becomes eligible for the waiver under this section.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.15.910 and 2004 c 275 s 51 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purpose of providing state general fund support topublic institutions of higher education, except for revenue waivedunder programs listed in subsections (3) and (4) of this section, andunless otherwise expressly provided in the omnibus state appropriationsact, the total amount of operating fees revenue waived, exempted, orreduced by a state university, a regional university, The EvergreenState College, or the community colleges as a whole, shall not exceedthe percentage of total gross authorized operating fees revenue in thissubsection. As used in this section, "gross authorized operating feesrevenue" means the estimated gross operating fees revenue as estimatedunder RCW 82.33.020 or as revised by the office of financialmanagement, before granting any waivers. This limitation applies toall tuition waiver programs established before or after July 1, 1992.
